name: TAX_BLOCK_POLYGON
description:
This dataset contains polygon records for tax blocks, likely representing geographic boundaries of tax map blocks within a city (the borough codes and block numbering are consistent with New York City tax lots). Each row is one block polygon, identified by borough (boro, values 1–5), block number, and an object ID. Records also carry tax map reference fields (section_number and volume_number), two geometry quality flags (eop_overlap_flag, marking blocks that overlap an end-of-page boundary, and jagged_st_flag, a rare flag for jagged street geometry), and polygon measurements (shape_area and shape_length). Audit fields record who created and last edited each record and when, though these are sparsely populated and many dates appear to be placeholders.
